Work item: Private files can be downloaded by unrelated signed-in users
Concrete change: Replace the shared authenticated static-file mount with attachment ownership and purpose checks. Separate deliberately public assets from private submissions, contracts, resumes and onboarding documents.
Acceptance criteria: An owner/assigned staff member can retrieve the attachment; unrelated free/student/recruiter accounts get 403/404 even with its exact URL; unauthenticated access stays denied.

Work item: Password reset leaves existing sessions valid
Concrete change: Version user sessions or maintain revocable server sessions. Rotate/invalidate old sessions on recovery and administrative password reset; give users a revoke-other-sessions action.
Acceptance criteria: After recovery, cookies created before the reset return 401; the new session and password work; reused reset tokens fail.

Work item: Unsubmitted code is lost on task switches and refresh
Concrete change: Autosave drafts per user/course/task/language, show save state, restore before rendering the editor, and warn when leaving work that has not been saved. Preserve the latest successful submission separately.
Acceptance criteria: Desktop and 390px mobile drafts survive task switching, Back/Forward, refresh, session expiry and sign-in; another account never inherits them. An interrupted save has a visible recovery path.
Evidence: evidence/browser-workflows.json — DRAFT-SWITCH/REFRESH; evidence/final-browser-checks.json — PAID-DRAFT-REFRESH; evidence/annotated-draft-loss-desktop.png; public/js/open.js:1361; public/js/dashboard.js:4853

Work item: A teacher can certify a student outside their course
Concrete change: Validate enrollment and the configured completion rule before course certification. Keep any exceptional administrative issuance as a separate permission with a recorded reason.
Acceptance criteria: An instructor cannot issue a course certificate to a nonmember or ineligible learner. Valid graduates can be certified once, and verification reflects the recorded completion basis.
Evidence: evidence/operations-initial.json — CERT-NONMEMBER; evidence/final-browser-checks.json — CERT-VERIFY-UI; evidence/certificate-verification.png; server.js:2778-2806

Work item: Several failed data requests leave permanent loading screens
Concrete change: Use a shared loading/error/empty/success state component. Catch render errors, retain existing content when possible, provide retry, and explain temporary feature unavailability in learner language.
Acceptance criteria: A failed, aborted or timed-out request removes the loader, announces a useful error and exposes Retry; a successful retry restores the screen without a full reload.
Evidence: evidence/browser-workflows.json — ERROR-ASSIGNMENTS; evidence/browser-survey.json — view-student-talent-profile, view-student-hiring-interest; evidence/annotated-loading-error.png; public/js/dashboard.js:1327,2816,3133

Work item: Challan is marked sent even when no email was sent
Concrete change: Track queued, provider-accepted and failed mail states. Advance the workflow only at the documented successful handoff; retain retry and a downloadable PDF. Repeated send attempts need deduplication.
Acceptance criteria: Disabled SMTP, provider rejection and network failure cannot produce a Sent status. A test-provider acknowledgement advances the correct record exactly once.

Work item: Teachers can award course gems to nonmembers
Concrete change: Require recipient enrollment in the authorized batch and record a reason and actor. Keep a separately authorized institute-wide award action if needed.
Acceptance criteria: A teacher’s course award to a nonmember fails and changes no totals; valid awards are persisted and auditable.

Work item: Quiz request body can override the authorized batch
Concrete change: Whitelist quiz fields and set batch_id exclusively from req.batch after parsing the body. Review analogous route/body ID merges.
Acceptance criteria: A conflicting body ID is rejected or ignored; every created quiz belongs to the URL batch that passed authorization; unauthorized batches are unchanged.

Work item: Automatic grading failure has no durable recovery workflow
Concrete change: Persist a grading job with pending/failed/retrying status and a staff retry path. Keep the previous completed attempt/grade until the replacement is successfully graded.
Acceptance criteria: Provider timeout/rejection can be retried without another upload; learners see a truthful status; successful recovery updates progress once; a failed retry does not erase an earned grade.
Evidence: evidence/api-checks.json — LEARN-05-submit-persist; evidence/browser-workflows.json — SUBMIT-RETRY; server.js:4090-4132; store.js:3955-3964

Work item: Advertised course bundle creates a zero-fee challan and cannot enroll
Concrete change: Model bundles as real offerings with component enrollments, authoritative prices and a batch choice for each required course. Until supported, remove the actionable bundle registration offer.
Acceptance criteria: The published PKR 43,500 price reaches the challan; payment clearance lets Admissions place the learner in every component; completion is atomic or explicitly recoverable.
Evidence: evidence/bundle-and-rules.json — BUNDLE-PRICE, BUNDLE-ENROLL; public/js/open.js:506-515,625-650; store.js:2355-2371; server.js:3930-3950

Work item: Course progress and certification use different pass rules
Concrete change: Choose and document one pass rule, then calculate progress and certificate eligibility on the server from that shared rule. Align all course copy.
Acceptance criteria: Boundary fixtures (one failed task/high average, exactly pass mark, missing grade, regrade) produce identical progress, completion and certificate eligibility across UI/API.

Work item: Saving cleared profile fields retains the old data
Concrete change: Distinguish omitted fields from explicit clears; allow empty/null values for optional fields and return the canonical saved profile.
Acceptance criteria: Clearing City, Goal and Links removes each stored value and keeps it empty after refresh and a new session; mandatory fields receive specific validation.

Work item: Authentication and refresh lose the intended destination
Concrete change: Give significant views stable URLs and preserve a validated same-origin returnTo through login, expiry and logout recovery. Restore the active route on load.
Acceptance criteria: A bookmarked course/task/settings route survives refresh; authentication returns there; Back/Forward retraces navigation; external return URLs are rejected.

Work item: Repeated course registration creates duplicate records
Concrete change: Define duplicate behavior per learner and offering, use idempotency keys, and show an existing registration receipt when the same request is retried.
Acceptance criteria: Double-click, timeout/retry and resubmission create one active registration per learner/offering, while registration for another course remains allowed.

Work item: Unknown course codes are accepted and stored
Concrete change: Resolve the offering server-side, reject missing/unknown codes, and store the authoritative title and price identifier rather than trusting client text.
Acceptance criteria: Unknown/missing/deactivated offerings return a field-level 400 and create no record; valid courses and modeled bundles use authoritative identifiers.

Work item: Live course navigation retains the Free-only filter
Concrete change: Make navigation mode and filter state one source of truth. Set or reset applicable filters on both mode changes and show active filters clearly.
Acceptance criteria: Switching between Free and Live consistently shows the advertised offerings; search and tier filters combine predictably and clearing filters restores results.

Work item: Coordinator UI exposes actions whose APIs reject that role
Concrete change: Define coordinator capabilities explicitly, then share them between API gates and visible navigation. Resolve whether course-chat participation is an intentional exception to read-only access.
Acceptance criteria: Every visible coordinator action has an allowed, scoped endpoint; unavailable actions are omitted/explained; any read-only exception is documented and tested.
Evidence: evidence/browser-survey.json — role-errors-coordinator, view-coordinator-admin-teachers, view-coordinator-admin-analytics; evidence/api-checks.json — SEC-04-coordinator-write

Work item: Marketing contradicts current dates, catalogue and gem rules
Concrete change: Drive counts, stage ranges and active cohort dates from the same data as enrollment and progress. Expire campaign urgency copy automatically.
Acceptance criteria: Dates match the active offering; historical campaigns cannot claim seats are filling; counts match catalogue definitions; every stage threshold matches the dashboard.
Evidence: evidence/browser-survey-public.json — landing-desktop, open-desktop; evidence/catalogue-snapshot.json; public/landing.html:426,503-520,624; store.js:31-38

Work item: Challenge review corrections can award the same win twice
Concrete change: Use a unique reward identity per challenge and learner. Reject unsupported review transitions or explicitly reconcile the previous award when an authorized correction changes the result.
Acceptance criteria: Approve/repeat/reject/reapprove cannot create two rewards for one win. Any reversal is visible and auditable; the displayed status agrees with earned gems.

Work item: Duplicate hackathon teammates receive duplicate prizes
Concrete change: Resolve teammate identifiers to a unique set of user IDs before validating team size. Enforce one prize per event/place/person and guard legacy duplicate records at finalization.
Acceptance criteria: Repeated username/reg-number aliases create one membership or a clear validation error. Every eligible teammate receives exactly one advertised prize after repeated finalize requests.

Work item: Modal keyboard focus escapes into the page
Concrete change: Move focus into the dialog, keep Tab/Shift+Tab inside, make the background inert and restore focus to its trigger.
Acceptance criteria: Opening, using and closing each dialog is possible with keyboard only; no focus reaches obscured controls.

Work item: Mobile discovery requires too much scrolling
Concrete change: Prioritize search and relevant categories, use concise cards, preserve filters and add progressive pagination/load more with a result count.
Acceptance criteria: A learner can find a specific free or paid course without traversing the full catalogue; filter state survives return from course detail.

Work item: Learning terminology and next steps compete
Concrete change: Use a stable hierarchy: Course → Module → Lesson → Task. State the actual completion policy next to progress and identify any final assessment explicitly.
Acceptance criteria: A learner can identify the next required action and all requirements for completion from the curriculum without reconciling contradictory labels.

Work item: Integration failures expose developer setup instructions
Concrete change: Show a user-facing unavailable message and recovery action; put configuration diagnostics in authorized system health/logs.
Acceptance criteria: Student-facing errors contain no environment-variable or infrastructure setup instructions and provide a next step.

Work item: Registration has no durable receipt/status destination
Concrete change: Return a reference and a status page with next steps, contact route, resend status and the selected offering. Keep sensitive payment data protected.
Acceptance criteria: After refresh or a missed email, the applicant can recover their registration status without creating another record.

Work item: Mandatory onboarding can obstruct exploration
Concrete change: Explain the immediate purpose; permit sign-out and returning later, and separate required account contact from optional promotional preferences.
Acceptance criteria: A new user can understand the requirement, correct an error, sign out or resume later without being trapped behind an overlay.

Work item: Unify public and portal learning destinations
Concrete change: Keep one recognizable account entry, role-aware navigation, and a clear switch between enrolled and free learning.
Acceptance criteria: A learner can explain their current location and reach both learning areas without signing in again.

Work item: Provide resumable applicant and learner onboarding
Concrete change: Add an onboarding checklist with saved progress and contextual links to the next action.
Acceptance criteria: A new/empty account has a relevant next action and returns to its unfinished step.

Work item: Make submission attempt history visible
Concrete change: Keep a versioned history of code/files, grading status and feedback, with explicit retry and restore actions.
Acceptance criteria: A learner can compare attempts and recover the last successful submission after a failed regrade.

Work item: Expose service availability as product state
Concrete change: Hide or explain unsupported AI, talent, image sharing and live-class actions using server capability metadata.
Acceptance criteria: A disabled integration never presents an action that leads only to an endless loader or raw setup instruction.

Work item: Establish repeatable staging workflow coverage
Concrete change: Provide seeded accounts and sandbox SMTP, AI, PostgreSQL, R2 and video services; promote this matrix into regression coverage for critical paths.
Acceptance criteria: Every release runs access-control, enrollment, submission/recovery, grading and certificate tests in an isolated environment.

Work item: Recommendation summaries end mid-word
Concrete change: Use line clamping with an ellipsis, concise editorial summaries and a clear course detail affordance.
Acceptance criteria: No summary ends with an unexplained cut word at desktop or mobile widths; full detail is reachable.

Work item: Small secondary links and dense navigation need touch review
Concrete change: Increase the padded hit area of secondary actions, group mobile navigation and keep labels readable.
Acceptance criteria: Primary actions have a 44px design target; small secondary links have adequate spacing/padding and can be selected without adjacent activation in touch tests.

Work item: Admin status presentation needs clearer operational meaning
Concrete change: Use clear Healthy / Disabled / Test mode / Failed labels, wrap diagnostic text and format separators once.
Acceptance criteria: Statuses and details stay readable at 1440px and 390px; a disabled/test integration is visually distinct from an available delivery service.

Work item: Add a focused role-based design system
Concrete change: Standardize headings, action placement, empty/error/loading states, dialogs, tables and mobile navigation across the portals.
Acceptance criteria: Equivalent tasks use the same labels, layout and keyboard behavior across roles.
